issue: Repeated paused retries could keep failing until a page reload because later failure stages reused the same in-memory image object and only Tesseract was reset.
fix: Every paused retry reloads the failed image from the IndexedDB checkpoint regardless of the processingError stage, with a fresh Blob/File fallback when checkpoint retrieval is unavailable.
Paused retry rebuilds both Tesseract and PaddleOCR runtime state; PaddleOCR dispose is bounded and stale initialization generations cannot repopulate the active runtime after a reset.
createImageBitmap and HTML Image decoding are bounded by timeout protection so a browser decoder stall cannot wait forever.
Recognition, classifier, food, nature, CSV, and normal UI behavior are unchanged.
